content.short: Kamino Finance automates concentrated liquidity management for DEX market makers.
content.description: Kamino Finance automates concentrated liquidity management for DEX market makers. It automatically sets, rebalances, and auto-compounds liquidity positions, reducing the barrier to entry for market making on a CLMM. Kamino also makes CLMM positions fungible through kTokens. The automation handles ongoing adjustments so users don't have to manage manual rebalancing. To start, users select a Kamino vault that fits their portfolio profile and market conditions, deposit funds, and Kamino takes care of the rest.
